implementation_choices.position_drills: drill_type SKILL_DRILLS_{WR,TE,DB,DL,OL}; SKILL_DRILLS_LB excluded (its 4 players are DL who ran only LB drills, so they leave the population). The 40, shuttle and 3-cone are excluded.
implementation_choices.drill_key: position group + drill name, e.g. 'WR:GAUNTLET_DRILL' (GAUNTLET_DRILL, OVER_SHOULDER_ADJUST, BACK_PEDAL_AND_REACT and PASS_RUSH_DRILL are run by different position groups).
implementation_choices.not_merged: DL SHORT_ZONE_BREAKS (2023-24, several attempts per player) and the 2025 drills SHORT_ZONE_BREAK_FLAT_WHEEL / _FORWARD / _INSIDE are kept as named: the 2025 names are different movements, not spellings. Because z-scores are formed within drill x session and every naming variant occurs in different draft years, a merge only changes the drill label and the distinct-drill count, never a z-score.
implementation_choices.attempt: segments.ATTEMPT_KEYS (event_id, nfl_id, drill_name, attempt); one trajectory each (no tracking gap inside any attempt; all frames 0.1 s apart; verified).
implementation_choices.attempt_peak: max SG speed (kinematics.add_kinematics, window 7, poly 2) over frames [EDGE, n - EDGE), EDGE = speed.EDGE = 3, as bdb27.speed smax for the 40.
implementation_choices.forty_peak: c40_smax from speed.combine_speed_table(speed.forty_attempts()): mean of the same interior SG peak over the player's QC-passing 40 attempts.
implementation_choices.attempt_qc: keep an attempt if its x/y path length is within [0.5, 2.5] x the median path of its drill x session (drops aborted attempts and tracking overruns that continue past the drill). Fixed from Combine data only, before any game data were loaded.
implementation_choices.sessions: segments.combine_sessions on the attempt table with drill = the drill key (> 10 min since the previous attempt start of the same drill and draft year opens a new session).
implementation_choices.z_scoring: ratio z-scored within drill x session over QC-passing attempts of players with a QC-passing tracked 40; attempts alone in their drill x session (no SD) are dropped.
implementation_choices.aggregation: drill-level value = mean of the player's attempt z-scores in that drill; player value = mean of drill-level values; >= 2 distinct drills (drill keys).
implementation_choices.stop_rule_input: player x drill rows (the drill-level values above) of population players, passed to reliability.cross_drill_icc(value, drill='drill', zscore=True, center_by=['drill', 'session']); its icc1 Spearman-Browns each player's ICC to his number of drills and averages over players.
implementation_choices.variant_no_division: attempt peak speed smax z-scored within drill x session (same attempts and aggregation).
implementation_choices.variant_median: player value = median (instead of mean) of his drill-level values. A per-drill median over attempts would be nearly vacuous (most drills have 1-2 attempts, where median = mean).
implementation_choices.play_max_speed: max raw `s` over all tracked frames of a REG player-play, from features.reg_season_tracking() (standardized, REG only), plays with max > 12 yd/s dropped: the features.game_top_speed / E001 definition.
implementation_choices.p1_quantiles: q95 = polars quantile(0.95) default ('nearest', as features.game_top_speed); median = midpoint median. Players need >= 50 such plays.
implementation_choices.p1_split_half: reliability.split_half_estimator by odd/even game (dense rank), fn = median/q95 of the half's plays, NaN below 25 plays in the half; Spearman-Brown to full length.
implementation_choices.p1_team_share: reliability.team_share on the per-play value play max / player's own q95 (all his plays), team_col = [team_abbr from player_play, season]; per position, and pooled on position-centered values. The shared full-sample q95 enters both halves, so the player variance (denominator) is slightly overstated and the team share slightly understated.
implementation_choices.p2_population: every population player (0 snaps if he never played); seasons = 2026 - draft_year.
implementation_choices.p2_variants: two separate variants: (a) log(1 + snaps per season); (b) (offensive + defensive + special-teams snaps) per season.
implementation_choices.p2_reliability: snaps are a recorded count (no measurement error); as context, the season-to-season correlation of off+def snap counts from player_play (players with 2+ available seasons), Spearman-Brown to the class's number of seasons.
implementation_choices.exploratory_starts: career_games_started / seasons, linkage.evaluate with expected_sign=+1 (same settings).
implementation_choices.exploratory_honors: Pro Bowl + All-Pro (1st and 2nd team) count; descriptive only (no test): number of honored players and their mean feature vs the rest, within position.
implementation_choices.leave_3_out: drop the 3 players contributing most to sign * x_res * y_res (supportive) and, separately, the 3 contributing least (contrary), using the B2 residuals of the harness; rerun the seed-free Freedman-Lane test (CV parts at minimal settings, not used). If a primary passes criterion 1, the supportive drop is also rerun at full settings for criteria 2-3.
implementation_choices.by_position: linkage.evaluate on each position alone (same settings), descriptive.
implementation_choices.multiplicity: BH across P1-P2 (the primary family); BH across every p-valued E010 test reported alongside.

p2_stability.note: snaps are a recorded count; this is stability, not measurement reliability

P1.corrected_ci95_scope: feature and target measurement error (beyond-B2 reliabilities); bounds are pooled within-position averages

P2.corrected_ci95_scope: feature measurement error only (snaps as recorded, rel_y = 1); for snaps read as a playing-time trait see post_hoc_review.p2_playing_time_trait; bounds are pooled within-position averages

post_hoc_review.label: post hoc, after the skeptic reviews (2026-10-15); descriptive unless a p is shown; no p here is in a prespecified BH family

choices.literal_median: prereg robustness 'drill-level median instead of mean', literal reading: drill value = median of the player's attempt z in that drill, player value = mean over >= 2 drills. Full harness settings (seed 0). The implemented variant (player-level median over drills) is kept as run.
choices.post_hoc_tests: linkage.evaluate, one-sided +, seed-free Freedman-Lane (n_perm_fl as the primaries); its CV parts run at minimal settings (n_repeats 2, n_perm 20) and are not reported.
choices.team_share: reliability.team_share on per-play play max / own q95: (a) the reported pooled construction (position-centered values, team_col [team_abbr, season]: most teammate pairs are cross-position); (b) same-position pairs only (team_col [team_abbr, season, position]); (c) the inverse-variance mean of the per-position estimates; (d) (b) on the role-adjusted per-play value.
choices.play_context: f_drill_intensity.play_context: cell = position | lined_up_position | run (player_play row with pass_result null) | route_ran | coverage (man / rush / deepzone / shortzone / na), from player_play.
choices.role_adjusted_p1: f_drill_intensity.role_adjusted_intensity: median(play max - cell mean + position mean) / q95 (raw), >= 50 plays; cell means over the P1 population's plays.
choices.role_mix: f_drill_intensity.ROLE_COVARIATES (shares over plays with a player_play row); as controls they enter position-specific (0 for other positions).
choices.sprint_controls: c40_smax and c40_tau (speed.combine_speed_table) added to the B1 block.
choices.censoring_types: per drill, share pe of used attempts whose interior peak is the last interior frame: censored-type pe >= 0.6, true-peak pe < 0.3, mixed otherwise (the football skeptic's cuts). True-peak feature = mean of the player's true-peak drill values, >= 2 such drills; threshold sensitivity with pe < 0.5 (the statistics skeptic's cut). The censored-vs-uncensored z comparison uses drills with 0.15 <= pe <= 0.85.
choices.heterogeneity: OLS F-test of feature x position interactions added to B2 + feature (P1 without TE, n 20).
choices.bootstrap: position-stratified case bootstrap of the pooled partial r, 2,000 replicates, seed 0; the design is rebuilt (and re-imputed) in every replicate.
choices.p2_playing_time: season-1 vs season-2 REG player_play row counts (classes 2023-24), correlated beyond B0 and beyond B2, Spearman-Brown to each player's seasons available (2026 - draft_year) and averaged. WR/TE rows are pass plays only, so this is a proxy for the snap count.
choices.p2_decomposition: partial r of the feature with P2 given B0 plus one block at a time (descriptive).

literal_drill_median.label: prespecified robustness, literal reading of the prereg's 'drill-level median' (run after review)

p1_coverage.note: WR/TE player_play REG rows are pass plays only, so P1 is per route for WR/TE and per snap for DB/DL/OL

p1_team_share.note: team_share cannot separate a player from his within-team role

drills_with_both_attempt_kinds.definition: drills whose share of peak-at-end attempts is within F.BOTH_KINDS (0.15-0.85)

tests.label: post hoc (after review)
tests.note: threshold sensitivity: drills with peak at end in < 50% of attempts

tests.label: post hoc (after review)
tests.note: threshold sensitivity: drills with peak at end in < 50% of attempts

decision.P1: P1 (median / q95 of REG play max speed: per route for WR/TE, per snap for DB/DL/OL; within position largely alignment and route-depth mix): fails c1_fl_p_and_sign, c2_excess_lb_gt_0_signed, c3_loco_2of3, c4_bh_q_lt_05, c6_seeds_and_leave3out; pooled within-position partial r -0.003 [-0.13, +0.12], one-sided p 0.521, BH q 0.79; pooled observed partial r above +0.10 ruled out (one-sided 95%; position-stratified bootstrap +0.11); per-position effects up to +0.41 (DB) not excluded (feature x position heterogeneity p 0.28, post hoc); one-sided MDE 0.16; reliability-corrected (beyond-B2) 95% interval [-0.19, +0.18]
decision.P2: P2 (off+def snaps per available season): fails c1_fl_p_and_sign, c2_excess_lb_gt_0_signed, c3_loco_2of3, c4_bh_q_lt_05, c6_seeds_and_leave3out; pooled within-position partial r -0.042 [-0.14, +0.06], one-sided p 0.792, BH q 0.79; pooled observed partial r above +0.04 ruled out (one-sided 95%; position-stratified bootstrap +0.04); per-position effects up to +0.24 (TE) not excluded (feature x position heterogeneity p 0.56, post hoc); one-sided MDE 0.13; reliability-corrected (beyond-B2) 95% interval [-0.17, +0.07] for feature error only (snaps as recorded); [-0.21, +0.09] if snaps per season is read as a playing-time trait (beyond-B2 stability 0.68, post hoc)
decision.verdict: KILL: no primary passes. feature reliability 0.74 (stop rule), 0.66 beyond B2; P1 split-half 0.73; P2 a recorded count; all >= 0.5, so the null is not a measurement failure. Bounds are pooled within-position averages.
